text:
lara-sales: Delta customer in POC hit a sudden wave of 5xxs during an investor demo. They're on Dedicated with no burstpool. Need triage + a short mitigation we can run now.
tom-support: Copy. Do we have sample errors or request ids? Any indication 503 vs 500?
delta-client: sending sanitized log lines: `2026-06-08T16:12:05Z ERROR id=reqA1 code=503 msg=capacity_throttled model=redwood-7b` and `2026-06-08T16:12:07Z ERROR id=reqA2 code=500 msg=worker_oom model=redwood-13b`. We ramped from ~8rps to ~160rps in ~90s.
rene-se: Looks like mixed mode failures: capacity_throttled from queue saturation and an OOM on the larger model. Autoscaler generated an event but pods became ready ~65s after spike.
kai-eng: For immediate mitigation: 1) switch demo traffic to a smaller quantized variant (rwd-7b-quant) as a routing fallback, 2) temporarily cap client concurrency and max_tokens, 3) manual scale up if they want to continue heavy ramp.
ops-bot: autoscaler_event id=evt-314 created=2026-06-08T16:13:10Z scaled_from=3 scaled_to=7 reason=queue_latency_spike pods_ready=16:14:15Z
lara-sales: Customer asked estimated cost for a 2hr manual scale to 6 GPUs. Need quick ballpark to include in quote.
rene-se: Ballpark: hourly_gpu_rate * extra_gpus * hours. I'll ping finance for exact numbers, but can give a conservative estimate now.
tom-support: Quick checks to run (please paste outputs): `rg "capacity_throttled|worker_oom" /var/log/runtime/*.log | tail -n 100`, `kubectl -n poc get events --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 50`, and capture one failing request id to trace.
delta-client: grabbed reqA1 and reqA2 logs and sent them. We're willing to reduce max_tokens to 512 for demo.
kai-eng: Also recommend toggling autoscaler config in POC namespace for the demo: `scale_up_cooldown=30s` and `cpu_threshold=60`. I'll prepare a one-line patch.
rene-se: Short mitigation message to send to customer (copyable): `1) Reduce max_tokens to 512; 2) Limit ramp to +10rps/sec up to 80rps; 3) Enable routing.fallback_variant=rwd-7b-quant; 4) Optional: request manual scale to 6 GPUs for 2hrs (cost estimate attached).`
lara-sales: I'll send that and request a 2hr window. Also flagging security questionnaire item: the customer asked if we log full prompt text in runtime logs during a POC.
tom-support: Standard: we redact prompt content in logs by default for POC tokens, but we can provide a short blurb for the security questionnaire. I'll attach the wording to the ticket.
ops-bot: support_ticket SUP-2026-1177 created by tom-support attached=logs,timeline
kai-eng: If errors persist after these mitigations, escalate to infra for scheduler hotfix to reduce pod readiness time. Also suggest pre-warming for scheduled demos.
delta-client: applying client-side caps now and enabling fallback. Will retest in 10m and report back. Thanks.
lara-sales: Great. I'll follow up with cost numbers and the security blurb. Keeping this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
